comment: Frame 018, printed p. 12: multiplication continued: a circle multiplied gives nothing; the products added in the place above, ten carried to the next place; the product of the example, 2326 by 214, 497764; the proof of doubling and of multiplication by casting out nines.

observations: The page number «( 12 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.
L19: the vertical bar between «bimus» and «numerum» marks the beginning of fol. 106 recto of the manuscript, which the note in the left margin, «car. 106 recto.», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L20-L23: «et hec est figura numeri, qui exiuit nobis de multiplicatione duorum milium et tercentorum uiginti sex in ducentis .xiiii., que sunt quadringenta milia et nonaginta septem milia et septingenta .lxiiii.»: the product of 2326 by 214 is given in words, 497,764, which is correct; the figure is not printed, and no four points mark its place.
L14: «fue-»: the hyphen stands 7 px from the e, further than the hyphens at the ends of the other lines; transcribed «fue-».

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L04 «dexteram ;» (22 px), L07 «differentiam ,» (18 px), L08 «uimus :» (20 px), L09 «unum :» (17 px), L11 «remanserit ,» (14 px) and L17 «mus ,» (18 px); without a space after the mark, L03 «nichil.Cumque» (8 px, the median word space of the line 17 px), L32 «errasti.Et» (9 px) and L33 «aliquo;et». L10 «sinistram;» (7 px before the semicolon) and L20 «multiplicatio:» (9 px) are set close.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: «quod» in the left margin beside L10, with «et» underlined; L10, a dark mark below the «d» of «aliquid»; «produxerit» in the left margin beside L13, a reading of «perduxerit»; «delebimus» beside L14, a reading of «debebimus»; «hec» beside L28, with «hoc» underlined; faint erased writing in the left margin beside L29; «?» beside L31; L33, a stroke under «quem». Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: «debebimus quicquid fuerit in differentia, que est super eam; et notabimus id quod exierit nobis ex multiplicatione in loco eius»: «debebimus», we shall owe, has no infinitive and gives no sense; the work requires that the figure in the place above be erased and the product written in its place, «delebimus», we shall delete; a reader of this copy wrote «delebimus» in the margin
critical_notes.impact: the rule of the work reads: delete the figure above and write the product in its place; whether the error is of the edition or of the manuscript is not shown by the print
